question.en: Which form of the main verb is ALWAYS used in the Passive Voice?
question.hi: पैसिव वॉइस (कर्मवाच्य) में मुख्य क्रिया का कौन सा रूप हमेशा उपयोग किया जाता है?

text.en: V1 (Base form)
text.hi: V1 (मूल रूप)

text.en: V2 (Past form)
text.hi: V2 (भूतकाल रूप)

text.en: V3 (Past Participle)
text.hi: V3 (पास्ट पार्टिसिपल)

text.en: V4 (Gerund / -ing form)
text.hi: V4 (जीरंड / -ing रूप)

explanation.en: Passive voice always uses the V3 (Past Participle) form of the main verb regardless of the tense.
explanation.hi: काल की परवाह किए बिना, पैसिव वॉइस में हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया के V3 (पास्ट पार्टिसिपल) रूप का उपयोग किया जाता है।

question.en: What happens to the tense of a sentence during voice transformation in English grammar?
question.hi: अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में वॉइस परिवर्तन के दौरान वाक्य के काल (Tense) का क्या होता है?

text.en: Tense changes to the next level
text.hi: काल अगले स्तर में बदल जाता है

text.en: Tense NEVER changes
text.hi: काल कभी नहीं बदलता है

text.en: Tense always becomes past tense
text.hi: काल हमेशा भूतकाल बन जाता है

text.en: Tense becomes present indefinite
text.hi: काल प्रेजेंट इंडेफिनेट बन जाता है

explanation.en: The tense never changes during voice transformation; only the structure changes to reflect passive meaning.
explanation.hi: वॉइस परिवर्तन के दौरान काल कभी नहीं बदलता है; पैसिव अर्थ दर्शाने के लिए केवल संरचना बदलती है।

question.en: Which type of verbs can be converted into Passive Voice?
question.hi: किस प्रकार की क्रियाओं को पैसिव वॉइस में बदला जा सकता है?

text.en: Intransitive Verbs (verbs without an object)
text.hi: अकर्मक क्रियाएं (बिना कर्म वाली क्रियाएं)

text.en: Transitive Verbs (verbs with an object)
text.hi: सकर्मक क्रियाएं (कर्म वाली क्रियाएं)

text.en: Linking verbs only
text.hi: केवल योजक क्रियाएं

text.en: All verbs indiscriminately
text.hi: सभी क्रियाएं बिना किसी भेद के

explanation.en: Only Transitive Verbs (verbs that take an object) can be converted to Passive Voice because the object becomes the subject.
explanation.hi: केवल सकرمक क्रियाओं (कर्म लेने वाली क्रियाएं) को पैसिव वॉइस में बदला जा सकता है क्योंकि कर्म ही कर्ता बनता है।

question.en: Change the voice: 'She writes a letter.'
question.hi: वाच्य बदलिए: 'She writes a letter.'

text.en: A letter was written by her.
text.hi: A letter was written by her.

text.en: A letter is written by her.
text.hi: A letter is written by her.

text.en: A letter has been written by her.
text.hi: A letter has been written by her.

text.en: A letter is being written by her.
text.hi: A letter is being written by her.

explanation.en: 'Writes' is Present Indefinite, so its passive structure is is/am/are + V3 ('is written').
explanation.hi: 'Writes' प्रेजेंट इंडेफिनेट है, इसलिए इसकी पैसिव संरचना is/am/are + V3 ('is written') है।

question.en: How many tenses in total CANNOT be converted into Passive Voice?
question.hi: कुल कितने कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता है?

text.en: Two
text.hi: दो

text.en: Three
text.hi: तीन

text.en: Four
text.hi: चार

text.en: Five
text.hi: पाँच

explanation.en: Four tenses cannot be converted into Passive Voice: 3 Perfect Continuous tenses and Future Continuous tense.
explanation.hi: चार कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में नहीं बदला जा सकता: 3 परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस काल और फ्यूचर कंटीन्यूअस काल।

question.en: Choose the correct passive form of: 'Ram killed Ravana.'
question.hi: 'Ram killed Ravana.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनिए।

text.en: Ravana is killed by Ram.
text.hi: Ravana is killed by Ram.

text.en: Ravana was killed by Ram.
text.hi: Ravana was killed by Ram.

text.en: Ravana has been killed by Ram.
text.hi: Ravana has been killed by Ram.

text.en: Ravana had been killed by Ram.
text.hi: Ravana had been killed by Ram.

explanation.en: 'Killed' is V2 (Past Indefinite), which takes was/were + V3 ('was killed').
explanation.hi: 'Killed' V2 (पास्ट इंडेफिनेट) है, जिसके साथ was/were + V3 ('was killed') का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: What additional word is introduced when converting Continuous tenses into Passive Voice?
question.hi: कंटीन्यूअस कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में बदलते समय कौन सा अतिरिक्त शब्द जोड़ा जाता है?

text.en: been
text.hi: been

text.en: being
text.hi: being

text.en: having
text.hi: having

text.en: to be
text.hi: to be

explanation.en: Continuous tenses take 'being' (is/am/are/was/were + being + V3) in passive voice.
explanation.hi: कंटीन्यूअस कालों में पैसिव वॉइस बनाते समय 'being' (is/am/are/was/were + being + V3) का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Identify the passive form of: 'They are playing cricket.'
question.hi: 'They are playing cricket.' का पैसिव रूप पहचानिए।

text.en: Cricket is played by them.
text.hi: Cricket is played by them.

text.en: Cricket was being played by them.
text.hi: Cricket was being played by them.

text.en: Cricket is being played by them.
text.hi: Cricket is being played by them.

text.en: Cricket has been played by them.
text.hi: Cricket has been played by them.

explanation.en: Present continuous takes 'is being' + V3 ('is being played').
explanation.hi: प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस में 'is being' + V3 ('is being played') का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: What word is added when converting Perfect tenses into Passive Voice?
question.hi: परफेक्ट कालों को पैसिव वॉइस में बदलते समय कौन सा शब्द जोड़ा जाता है?

text.en: being
text.hi: being

text.en: been
text.hi: been

text.en: done
text.hi: done

text.en: had
text.hi: had

explanation.en: Perfect tenses take 'been' (has/have/had + been + V3) in passive voice.
explanation.hi: परफेक्ट कालों में पैसिव वॉइस बनाते समय 'been' (has/have/had + been + V3) का प्रयोग होता है।

question.en: Change the voice: 'He has stolen my pen.'
question.hi: वाच्य बदलिए: 'He has stolen my pen.'

text.en: My pen is stolen by him.
text.hi: My pen is stolen by him.

text.en: My pen was stolen by him.
text.hi: My pen was stolen by him.

text.en: My pen has been stolen by him.
text.hi: My pen has been stolen by him.

text.en: My pen had been stolen by him.
text.hi: My pen had been stolen by him.

explanation.en: Present perfect 'has stolen' changes to 'has been stolen' in passive voice.
explanation.hi: प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट 'has stolen' पैसिव वॉइस में 'has been stolen' में बदल जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice of: 'Open the door.'
question.hi: 'Open the door.' का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनिए।

text.en: The door is opened.
text.hi: The door is opened.

text.en: Let the door be opened.
text.hi: Let the door be opened.

text.en: Let the door opened.
text.hi: Let the door opened.

text.en: The door should open.
text.hi: The door should open.

explanation.en: Imperative sentences expressing a command use the structure: Let + object + be + V3 ('Let the door be opened').
explanation.hi: आज्ञासूचक वाक्यों के लिए संरचना का उपयोग होता है: Let + object + be + V3 ('Let the door be opened').

question.en: What is the correct passive form of: 'Who taught you English?'
question.hi: 'Who taught you English?' का सही पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: Who was taught English by you?
text.hi: Who was taught English by you?

text.en: By whom were you taught English?
text.hi: By whom were you taught English?

text.en: Whom was English taught by you?
text.hi: Whom was English taught by you?

text.en: By who you were taught English?
text.hi: By who you were taught English?

explanation.en: 'Who' changes to 'By whom' in interrogative sentences, followed by auxiliary verb and object-turned-subject.
explanation.hi: प्रश्नसूचक वाक्यों में 'Who' बदलकर 'By whom' हो जाता है, जिसके बाद सहायक क्रिया और कर्ता बनता हुआ कर्म आता है।

question.en: Identify the passive voice of: 'Please help me.'
question.hi: 'Please help me.' का पैसिव वॉइस पहचानिए।

text.en: You are requested to help me.
text.hi: You are requested to help me.

text.en: You are ordered to help me.
text.hi: You are ordered to help me.

text.en: Let me be helped please.
text.hi: Let me be helped please.

text.en: I am requested to help you.
text.hi: I am requested to help you.

explanation.en: Sentences starting with 'Please' indicate a request and are converted using 'You are requested to'.
explanation.hi: 'Please' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य अनुरोध को दर्शाते हैं और इन्हें 'You are requested to' का उपयोग करके बदला जाता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive form: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव रूप चुनिए: 'They say that honesty is the best policy.'

text.en: Honesty is said to be the best policy.
text.hi: Honesty is said to be the best policy.

text.en: It is said that honesty is the best policy.
text.hi: It is said that honesty is the best policy.

text.en: Both A and B are correct.
text.hi: A और B दोनों सही हैं।

text.en: Neither A nor B is correct.
text.hi: न तो A और न ही B सही है।

explanation.en: Impersonal passive constructions with 'They say' can be correctly converted into either 'It is said that...' or 'Subject + is said to be...'.
explanation.hi: 'They say' वाले अवैयक्तिक पैसिव वाक्यों को या तो 'It is said that...' या 'Subject + is said to be...' में बदला जा सकता है।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'The police arrested the thief.'
question.hi: 'The police arrested the thief.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: The thief was arrested by the police.
text.hi: The thief was arrested by the police.

text.en: The thief was arrested.
text.hi: The thief was arrested.

text.en: Both A and B are correct (Option B is preferred when agent is obvious).
text.hi: A और B दोनों सही हैं (जब कर्ता स्पष्ट हो तो B अधिक उपयुक्त है)।

text.en: The thief is arrested by the police.
text.hi: The thief is arrested by the police.

explanation.en: When the agent (like police, public, someone) is obvious or understood, it can be omitted in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: जब कर्ता (जैसे पुलिस, जनता आदि) स्पष्ट या ज्ञात होता है, तो पैसिव वॉइस में उसे हटाया जा सकता है।

question.en: Change the voice: 'She is to write a letter.'
question.hi: वाच्य बदलिए: 'She is to write a letter.'

text.en: A letter is written by her.
text.hi: A letter is written by her.

text.en: A letter is to be written by her.
text.hi: A letter is to be written by her.

text.en: A letter was to be written by her.
text.hi: A letter was to be written by her.

text.en: A letter has to be written by her.
text.hi: A letter has to be written by her.

explanation.en: Infinitive structures with 'is/am/are/was/were + to + V1' become 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3' in passive voice.
explanation.hi: 'is/am/are/was/were + to + V1' वाली इनफिनिटिव संरचनाएँ पैसिव वॉइस में 'is/am/are/was/were + to be + V3' हो जाती हैं।

question.en: Choose the correct passive of: 'Do not insult the poor.'
question.hi: 'Do not insult the poor.' का सही पैसिव चुनिए।

text.en: Let the poor not be insulted.
text.hi: Let the poor not be insulted.

text.en: The poor should not insulted.
text.hi: The poor should not insulted.

text.en: Let not the poor be insult.
text.hi: Let not the poor be insult.

text.en: You are ordered to insult the poor.
text.hi: You are ordered to insult the poor.

explanation.en: Negative imperative sentences follow the pattern: Let + object + not + be + V3 ('Let the poor not be insulted').
explanation.hi: नकारात्मक आज्ञासूचक वाक्य इस नियम का पालन करते हैं: Let + object + not + be + V3 ('Let the poor not be insulted').

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'People speak English all over the world.'
question.hi: 'People speak English all over the world.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: English is spoken all over the world by people.
text.hi: English is spoken all over the world by people.

text.en: English is spoken all over the world.
text.hi: English is spoken all over the world.

text.en: English was spoken all over the world.
text.hi: English was spoken all over the world.

text.en: English has been spoken all over the world.
text.hi: English has been spoken all over the world.

explanation.en: When the subject 'People' is indefinite/general, 'by people' is omitted in the passive voice.
explanation.hi: जब कर्ता 'People' अनिश्चित या सामान्य हो, तो पैसिव वॉइस में 'by people' को हटा दिया जाता है।

question.en: Identify the correct passive voice: 'Smoke filled the room.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानिए: 'Smoke filled the room.'

text.en: The room was filled by smoke.
text.hi: The room was filled by smoke.

text.en: The room was filled with smoke.
text.hi: The room was filled with smoke.

text.en: The room is filled with smoke.
text.hi: The room is filled with smoke.

text.en: The room had been filled by smoke.
text.hi: The room had been filled by smoke.

explanation.en: Certain verbs take fixed prepositions instead of 'by'. 'Fill' takes 'with' ('filled with smoke').
explanation.hi: कुछ क्रियाएं 'by' के स्थान पर निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग (preposition) लेती हैं। 'Fill' के साथ 'with' का प्रयोग होता है ('filled with smoke').

question.en: Choose the correct passive form of: 'The container contains water.'
question.hi: 'The container contains water.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनिए।

text.en: Water is contained by the container.
text.hi: Water is contained by the container.

text.en: Water is contained in the container.
text.hi: Water is contained in the container.

text.en: Water was contained in the container.
text.hi: Water was contained in the container.

text.en: Water has been contained by the container.
text.hi: Water has been contained by the container.

explanation.en: The verb 'contain' takes the fixed preposition 'in' in the passive voice ('contained in').
explanation.hi: क्रिया 'contain' पैसिव वॉइस में अपने साथ निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग 'in' लेती है ('contained in').

question.en: Identify the correct passive voice of: 'His conduct surprised me.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानिए: 'His conduct surprised me.'

text.en: I was surprised by his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised by his conduct.

text.en: I was surprised at his conduct.
text.hi: I was surprised at his conduct.

text.en: I am surprised with his conduct.
text.hi: I am surprised with his conduct.

text.en: I had been surprised at his conduct.
text.hi: I had been surprised at his conduct.

explanation.en: The verb 'surprise' takes the fixed preposition 'at' instead of 'by' in the passive voice ('surprised at').
explanation.hi: क्रिया 'surprise' पैसिव वॉइस में 'by' के स्थान पर निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग 'at' लेती है ('surprised at').

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice of: 'Rose smells sweet.'
question.hi: 'Rose smells sweet.' का सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनिए।

text.en: Rose is sweet when it is smelled.
text.hi: Rose is sweet when it is smelled.

text.en: Sweet is smelled by rose.
text.hi: Sweet is smelled by rose.

text.en: Rose is smelled sweetly.
text.hi: Rose is smelled sweetly.

text.en: Rose was sweet when smelled.
text.hi: Rose was sweet when smelled.

explanation.en: Verbs of sensation like 'smell', 'taste', 'feel' (quasi-passive verbs) are converted as: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it is + V3.
explanation.hi: 'smell', 'taste', 'feel' जैसी संवेदी क्रियाओं (quasi-passive verbs) को इस प्रकार बदला जाता है: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it is + V3।

question.en: What is the passive form of: 'They elected him leader.'
question.hi: 'They elected him leader.' का पैसिव रूप क्या है?

text.en: Leader was elected him by them.
text.hi: Leader was elected him by them.

text.en: He was elected leader by them.
text.hi: He was elected leader by them.

text.en: He is elected leader.
text.hi: He is elected leader.

text.en: He was elected as leader by them.
text.hi: He was elected as leader by them.

explanation.en: In sentences with objective complement ('him' -> 'He', leaving 'leader' as complement), the object 'him' becomes the subject ('He was elected leader').
explanation.hi: ऑब्जेक्टिव कॉम्प्लीमेंट वाले वाक्यों में कर्म 'He' कर्ता बन जाता है और कॉम्प्लीमेंट वैसे ही रहता है ('He was elected leader').

question.en: Identify the correct passive voice: 'Everyone knows that honesty pays.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव वॉइस पहचानिए: 'Everyone knows that honesty pays.'

text.en: It is known to everyone that honesty pays.
text.hi: It is known to everyone that honesty pays.

text.en: Honesty is known to be paid by everyone.
text.hi: Honesty is known to be paid by everyone.

text.en: That honesty pays is known by everyone.
text.hi: That honesty pays is known by everyone.

text.en: Both A and C are grammatically correct.
text.hi: A और C दोनों व्याकरणिक रूप से सही हैं।

explanation.en: Complex sentences with noun clauses can take 'It is known to...' or have the entire clause as subject, and 'know' takes 'to' instead of 'by'.
explanation.hi: नाउन क्लॉज़ वाले जटिल वाक्यों में 'It is known to...' का प्रयोग हो सकता है या पूरा क्लॉज़ कर्ता बन सकता है, और 'know' के साथ 'to' आता है।

question.en: Choose the correct passive form of: 'He pleased me.'
question.hi: 'He pleased me.' का सही पैसिव रूप चुनिए।

text.en: I was pleased by him.
text.hi: I was pleased by him.

text.en: I was pleased with him.
text.hi: I was pleased with him.

text.en: I am pleased at him.
text.hi: I am pleased at him.

text.en: I was pleased for him.
text.hi: I was pleased for him.

explanation.en: The verb 'please' takes the fixed preposition 'with' when referring to a person in the passive voice ('pleased with').
explanation.hi: पैसिव वॉइस में व्यक्ति के संदर्भ में क्रिया 'please' अपने साथ निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग 'with' लेती है ('pleased with').

question.en: What is the passive voice of: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
question.hi: 'Quinine tastes bitter.' का पैसिव वॉइस क्या है?

text.en: Bitter is tasted by quinine.
text.hi: Bitter is tasted by quinine.

text.en: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
text.hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.

text.en: Quinine was tasted bitter.
text.hi: Quinine was tasted bitter.

text.en: Quinine is tasted bitterly.
text.hi: Quinine is tasted bitterly.

explanation.en: Quasi-passive verb 'taste' follows the rule: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it is + V3 ('Quinine is bitter when it is tasted').
explanation.hi: अर्ध-पैसिव क्रिया 'taste' नियम का पालन करती है: Subject + is/am/are + adjective + when + it is + V3 ('Quinine is bitter when it is tasted').

question.en: Identify the passive form of: 'Let him do this work.'
question.hi: 'Let him do this work.' का पैसिव रूप पहचानिए।

text.en: Let this work be done by him.
text.hi: Let this work be done by him.

text.en: This work should be done by him.
text.hi: This work should be done by him.

text.en: Let this work done by him.
text.hi: Let this work done by him.

text.en: He should be let to do this work.
text.hi: He should be let to do this work.

explanation.en: Imperative sentences starting with 'Let + indirect object' retain 'Let' in the passive voice: Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object.
explanation.hi: 'Let + indirect object' से शुरू होने वाले आज्ञासूचक वाक्य पैसिव वॉइस में 'Let' को बनाए रखते हैं: Let + direct object + be + V3 + by + indirect object।

question.en: Choose the correct passive voice: 'It is time to shut the shop.'
question.hi: सही पैसिव वॉइस चुनिए: 'It is time to shut the shop.'

text.en: It is time for the shop to be shut.
text.hi: It is time for the shop to be shut.

text.en: It is time the shop is shut.
text.hi: It is time the shop is shut.

text.en: The shop is time to be shut.
text.hi: The shop is time to be shut.

text.en: It is time for shop to shut.
text.hi: It is time for shop to shut.

explanation.en: Sentences starting with 'It is time to + V1 + object' change to 'It is time for + object + to be + V3'.
explanation.hi: 'It is time to + V1 + object' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्य 'It is time for + object + to be + V3' में बदल जाते हैं।

question.en: What is the passive voice of: 'Nothing can be achieved without hard work.' (Trick question: analyze voice direction)
question.hi: 'Nothing can be achieved without hard work.' का पैसिव वॉइस क्या है? (ट्रिक प्रश्न: वाच्य दिशा का विश्लेषण करें)

text.en: Without hard work, one can achieve nothing.
text.hi: Without hard work, one can achieve nothing.

text.en: Hard work cannot achieve anything.
text.hi: Hard work cannot achieve anything.

text.en: It is already in passive voice; changing to active gives 'We can achieve nothing without hard work.'
text.hi: यह पहले से ही पैसिव वॉइस में है; एक्टिव में बदलने पर 'We can achieve nothing without hard work' बनता है।

text.en: Both A and C are correct.
text.hi: A और C दोनों सही हैं।

explanation.en: The given sentence 'Nothing can be achieved...' is already in the passive voice (modal + be + V3). Its active equivalent can be expressed as option A or generalized active forms.
explanation.hi: दिया गया वाक्य पहले से ही पैसिव वॉइस में है (modal + be + V3)। इसका सक्रिय रूप विकल्प A या सामान्यीकृत रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

question.en: Identify the correct passive form of: 'They obliged me to go.'
question.hi: 'They obliged me to go.' का सही पैसिव रूप पहचानिए।

text.en: I was obliged to go by them.
text.hi: I was obliged to go by them.

text.en: I was obliged by them to go.
text.hi: I was obliged by them to go.

text.en: To go was obliged to me by them.
text.hi: To go was obliged to me by them.

text.en: I had been obliged to go.
text.hi: I had been obliged to go.

explanation.en: When converting sentences with object + infinitive, the object becomes subject, followed by passive verb and the infinitive remains intact at the end ('I was obliged to go by them').
explanation.hi: ऑब्जेक्ट + इनफिनिटिव वाले वाक्यों में, कर्म कर्ता बनता है, जिसके बाद पैसिव क्रिया आती है और इनफिनिटिव अंत में वैसा ही रहता है।
